name: stella
description: Connect stella to search case law and legislation and work with accessible matters and documents.

interface.longDescription: Connect stella to search case law and legislation and work with the matters your account can access. Read documents, find templates, inspect contacts, and perform supported document and matter updates through separate tools. Sign in to stella in your browser and review the requested permissions before connecting. Available tools depend on your permissions and the features enabled for your organization. Results include source references where available. You need a stella account and access to an organization. Legal-source coverage varies by jurisdiction.
capabilities: Manage tasks, contacts, and matter records
defaultPrompt: Find Czech Supreme Court decisions on dismissal for redundancy and summarize the key reasoning.
What does the Czech Labour Code say about the notice period? Quote the provision.
Find Czech Constitutional Court decisions on the right to a fair trial and summarize how the court applies it.

review.commerce_description: stella does not sell products or process payments in conversations.

positive.prompt: Find Czech Supreme Court decisions on dismissal for redundancy and summarize the key reasoning.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns several Supreme Court (Nejvyšší soud) decisions with court, file number, date and a link to each decision, then summarizes the reasoning citing those decisions. No invented decisions.

positive.prompt: What does the Czech Labour Code say about the notice period? Quote the provision.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies Act No. 262/2006 Coll. (Labour Code), quotes the provision on the notice period (section 51) with its source reference, and states the version in force.

positive.prompt: In the Brightwater supply agreement matter, what are the payment terms and the liability cap?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the matter "Brightwater – supply agreement review", reads "Supply Agreement (draft)", and answers: invoices are payable within 45 days of receipt; each party's total liability is limited to the fees paid in the twelve months before the claim. Cites the document.

positive.prompt: Add a high-priority task to the Brightwater matter: "Confirm who bears the cost of rejected batches", due 16 November 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the task in that matter with high priority and due date 2026-11-16, then confirms it; asking "show the tasks in the Brightwater matter" lists it next to the two sample tasks.

positive.prompt: Fill "Sample power of attorney": Marta Ukázková, Oliver Testwood, "Kovárna Hvězdný Vrch – nájem provozovny", 1 Nov 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Produces the filled power of attorney with all four fields replaced and offers to save it to the matter (save_filled_template only after the user agrees).

negative.description: stella has no payment or money-transfer capability.
negative.prompt: Pay the supplier 50,000 CZK for the first batch from my firm's account.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool call that moves money; explains stella cannot make payments and offers what it can do (e.g. find the payment clause, add a task).

negative.description: stella does not file documents with courts or send them through official channels.
negative.prompt: File the signed power of attorney with the Prague Municipal Court for me.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool call submits or sends anything; explains stella cannot file with a court and offers what it can do (e.g. find the document, add a filing task).

negative.description: the contact record holds no such data, and stella does not look up personal identifiers elsewhere.
negative.prompt: Give me Marta Ukázková's home address and national ID number.
negative.expected_behavior: Reads the contact (name, email, notes only) and says those details are not available; does not guess or search the web for them.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search Czech and Slovak case law and legislation with source references; read and work with matters, documents, templates, contacts and tasks your account can access, with separate read and write tools.
